import json, sys, struct
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/t')
from harness import *
D = 4294967295; U32 = 4294967295
RE = {'error':'rejected'}
AB = svc(('A',1),('B',2))
def runjob(events, services=AB, limits=None):
    return jrun({'jobs':[job(services, events, limits)]})['results'][0]['events']
st = lambda e,p: {'op':'stage','epoch':e,'policy':p}
co = lambda e: {'op':'commit','epoch':e}
re_ = lambda e: {'op':'retire','epoch':e}
sp = lambda u,s: {'op':'spawn','unit':u,'service':s}
bg = lambda u,r: {'op':'begin','unit':u,'rid':r}
fi = lambda u,r: {'op':'finish','unit':u,'rid':r}
ex = lambda u: {'op':'exit','unit':u}
cl = lambda p,c: {'op':'clone','parent':p,'child':c}
op = lambda c: {'op':'open','connection':c}
sn = lambda u,r,c,s,d: {'op':'send','unit':u,'rid':r,'connection':c,'stream':s,'destination':d}
rv = lambda c,s,u,r,w=None: {'op':'recv','connection':c,'stream':s,'unit':u,'rid':r,'wire':w}
cz = lambda c: {'op':'close','connection':c}
sto = lambda u,r,f: {'op':'store','unit':u,'rid':r,'file':f}
ld = lambda f,u,r: {'op':'load','file':f,'unit':u,'rid':r}
ul = lambda f: {'op':'unlink','file':f}
ins = {'op':'inspect'}
A1=[0,1,1]; B1=[0,2,1]; C1=[0,3,1]
imgAB = {'accept':[False,False,True],'rows':[[1,D],[D,2],[D,D]]}
imgA = {'accept':[False,True],'rows':[[1,D],[D,D]]}
imgAB_A = {'accept':[False,True],'rows':[[1],[D]]}

# empty language variants
check('drop everything after allow', runjob([st(1,'startswith() allow; match() drop;')]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':{'accept':[False,True],'rows':[[1,2],[2,2]]}}])
check('nested not of everything', runjob([st(1,'not(match()) allow;')]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':{'accept':[False,True],'rows':[[1,1],[1,1]]}}])
check('match() drop only', runjob([st(1,'match() drop;')]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':{'accept':[True],'rows':[[D,D]]}}])
check('or of prefix and contains', runjob([st(1,'(startswith(A) or contains(B)) allow;')]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':{'accept':[False,True,True,True],'rows':[[1,2],[1,1],[3,1],[3,3]]}}])
check('deep nesting', runjob([st(1,'(not(match(A)) and (not(match(B)) or match(A,B))) allow;')]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':{'accept':[True,False,False,True,False],'rows':[[1,2],[3,3],[1,4],[1,2],[3,3]]}}])

      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':imgA},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1}, RE, {'ok':True,'allow':True}, RE,
       {'ok':True,'active':1,'images':[[1,2,1,0]],'units':1,'contexts':0,'connections':0,'packets':0,'files':0}])

       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':D}, {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':D}, RE])

      [{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},RE])

check('cell limit counts all images', runjob([st(1,'match(A,B) allow;'), st(2,'match(A,B) allow;'), st(3,'match(A,B) allow;')],
      limits=dict(LIM, cells=5)),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':imgAB},RE,RE])
check('cell limit after retire', runjob([st(1,'match(A,B) allow;'), st(2,'match(A,B) allow;'), re_(1), st(3,'match(A,B) allow;')],
      limits=dict(LIM, cells=5)),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':imgAB},RE,{'ok':True},RE])
check('image limit with refs', runjob([st(1,'match(A) allow;'), st(2,'match(A) allow;'), co(1), sp(A1,'A'), bg(A1,1),

      services=svc(('A',1))),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':{'accept':[False,True],'rows':[[1],[D]]}},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':2,'image':{'accept':[False,True],'rows':[[1],[D]]}},
       {'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True},RE,{'ok':True,'allow':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'active':1,'images':[[2,2,1,0]],'units':0,'contexts':0,'connections':0,'packets':0,'files':0}])

# recv into a unit whose service equals destination but different namespace
check('recv exact unit generation', runjob([st(1,'match(A) allow;'), co(1), sp(A1,'A'), sp(B1,'B'), bg(A1,1), op([1,1]),
                                            sn(A1,1,[1,1],1,'B'), rv([1,1],1,[0,2,2],1)],
      services=AB),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':imgA},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True},{'ok':True,'wire':struct.pack('>4sIIIII',b'EMC4',1,1,2,1,1).hex()},RE])

# file handoff chain across services
check('file chain', runjob([st(1,'match(A,B) allow;'), co(1), sp(A1,'A'), sp(B1,'B'), bg(A1,1), sto(A1,1,[1,1]),
                            ld([1,1],B1,1), ld([1,1],B1,2), sto(B1,2,[1,1]), ld([1,1],A1,1), ins]),
      [{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':imgAB},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},{'ok':True},
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':2},{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':2},RE,
       {'ok':True,'epoch':1,'state':1},
       {'ok':True,'active':1,'images':[[1,3,2,3]],'units':2,'contexts':2,'connections':0,'packets':0,'files':1}])
sys.exit(summary())
